_doc: Hand-maintained data manifest (reviewed). 'bed' = device-recorded room audio (audio_16bit*.wav, int16 = I2S word >> 16) used as background for mixing and as ambient negatives. Splits are by recording/time block, never by random window. Held-out blocks are NEVER used for training or threshold selection.

excluded_runs.20260926_213821_m1_smoke_warm: captured with Philips framing (1-bit misalignment, E-18) — not device-representative
excluded_runs.20260926_221709_m1_sessionA_cold: contains speaker S01 speech; S01 is the held-out test speaker
excluded_runs.20260927_130649_kw_S01: v0/v1: TEST (speaker-held-out). From v2 on: TRAINING data (real_train_runs) — v0/v1 results on it stay valid for v0/v1 only
excluded_runs.20260927_151127_kw_S01_s2: VALIDATION only (model/threshold selection, DEC-18) — never trained on

_night_split_declared: 2026-09-27 ~20:05, BEFORE recording: ambient_night_20260927 hourly chunks c000-c004 (first 5 h) = TRAINING beds + hard-negative mining for v3; chunks c005 and later = HELD-OUT false-activation test (never trained on, never used for selection). S01 session 3 (20260927_195253_kw_S01_s3) = TEST for v2b; any v3 use must be declared.

long_run_negatives._note: TRAINING hours only (declared split). Hard negatives = where v2b's live device posterior >= 0.30.

_split_note_v2: v2 split (2026-09-27 18:00): train = S01 session 1 + ambient_day c000-c001 + TTS v2 train speakers + LibriSpeech train speakers; validation = S01 session 2 (selection only); held-out test = ambient_day c002, overnight ambient, and any NEW session/speaker recorded after v2 is frozen.
_bed_train_note: ambient_day c000 = 13:45-14:15 household audio (may include speaker S01 talking normally; never the keyword by instruction). Later ambient_day chunks are reserved: c001-c003 train in the final build, c004+ HELD-OUT for the false-activation test.
